title: Billing tests need manual setup
description: Integration tests need a hand-built database copy, so changes to billing wait for a tester.
interest: About 2 extra days per billing change; 6 changes per month

title: Framework security support ends
description: Web framework major version reaches end of security support in 9 months.
interest: Unpatched vulnerabilities after end of support

title: Shared database between orders and stock
description: Orders and stock services write to the same tables, so both teams must coordinate every schema change.
interest: Joint releases; 2 of the last 10 incidents involved this coupling

title: Alerts on CPU instead of SLOs
description: Pages fire on CPU spikes that do not affect users. On-call ignores them.

title: Nightly report has no runbook
description: Only one engineer knows how to rerun the nightly regulatory report after a failure.
interest: Key-person risk; late regulatory submission if that engineer is away
